info.name: Context Brand Intelligence Web Extraction API

items.docs: Crawl a website, use the provided JSON Schema and instructions to prioritize relevant internal links, and extract structured data from the selected pages.

params.name: domain
params.description: Company domain to analyze, such as `stripe.com`. Full http(s) URLs are accepted and normalized to their domain.

params.name: numCompetitors
params.description: Exact number of direct competitors to return. Defaults to 5.

params.name: timeoutMS
params.description: Optional timeout in milliseconds for the request. If the request takes longer than this value, it will be aborted with a 408 status code. Maximum allowed value is 300000ms (5 minutes).

params.name: tags
params.description: Optional comma-separated caller-defined tags for tracking this request. Tags are recorded on the request's usage log and can be used to filter usage on the dashboard usage page. Up to 20 tags, each 1-50 characters.

items.docs: Analyze a company's landing page and web search evidence to return direct competitors for the same product or market.

params.name: domain
params.description: Domain name to extract styleguide from (e.g., 'example.com', 'google.com'). The domain will be automatically normalized and validated. You must provide either 'domain' or 'directUrl', but not both.

params.name: directUrl
params.description: A specific URL to fetch the styleguide from directly, bypassing domain resolution (e.g., 'https://example.com/design-system'). When provided, the styleguide is extracted from this exact URL. You must provide either 'domain' or 'directUrl', but not both.

params.name: maxAgeMs
params.description: Maximum age in milliseconds for cached brand data before the API performs a hard refresh. Defaults to 3 months (7776000000 ms). Values below 1 day (86400000 ms) are clamped to 1 day; values above 1 year (31536000000 ms) are clamped to 1 year.

params.name: timeoutMS
params.description: Optional timeout in milliseconds for the request. If the request takes longer than this value, it will be aborted with a 408 status code. Maximum allowed value is 300000ms (5 minutes).

params.name: colorScheme
params.description: Optional browser color scheme to emulate for websites that respond to prefers-color-scheme. This value is part of the styleguide cache key.

params.name: tags
params.description: Optional comma-separated caller-defined tags for tracking this request. Tags are recorded on the request's usage log and can be used to filter usage on the dashboard usage page. Up to 20 tags, each 1-50 characters.

items.docs: Extract a comprehensive design system from a website including colors, typography, spacing, shadows, and UI components.

params.name: directUrl
params.description: A specific URL to fetch fonts from directly, bypassing domain resolution (e.g., 'https://example.com/design-system'). When provided, fonts are extracted from this exact URL. You must provide either 'domain' or 'directUrl', but not both.

params.name: timeoutMS

items.docs: Scrape font information from a website including font families, usage statistics, fallbacks, and element/word counts.

params.name: input
params.description: Brand domain or title to retrieve NAICS code for. If a valid domain is provided, it will be used for classification, otherwise, we will search for the brand using the provided title.

params.name: minResults
params.description: Minimum number of NAICS codes to return. Must be at least 1. Defaults to 1.

params.name: maxResults
params.description: Maximum number of NAICS codes to return. Must be between 1 and 10. Defaults to 5.

params.name: timeoutMS
params.description: Optional timeout in milliseconds for the request. If the request takes longer than this value, it will be aborted with a 408 status code. Maximum allowed value is 300000ms (5 minutes).

params.name: tags
params.description: Optional comma-separated caller-defined tags for tracking this request. Tags are recorded on the request's usage log and can be used to filter usage on the dashboard usage page. Up to 20 tags, each 1-50 characters.

items.docs: Classify any brand into 2022 NAICS industry codes from its domain or name.

params.name: input
params.description: Brand domain or title to retrieve SIC code for. If a valid domain is provided, it will be used for classification, otherwise, we will search for the brand using the provided title.

params.name: type
params.description: Which SIC dataset to classify against. `original_sic` uses the 1987 Standard Industrial Classification system; `latest_sec` uses the current SIC list as published by the SEC. Defaults to `original_sic`.

params.name: minResults
params.description: Minimum number of SIC codes to return. Must be at least 1. Defaults to 1.

params.name: maxResults
params.description: Maximum number of SIC codes to return. Must be between 1 and 10. Defaults to 5.

params.name: timeoutMS
params.description: Optional timeout in milliseconds for the request. If the request takes longer than this value, it will be aborted with a 408 status code. Maximum allowed value is 300000ms (5 minutes).

params.name: tags
params.description: Optional comma-separated caller-defined tags for tracking this request. Tags are recorded on the request's usage log and can be used to filter usage on the dashboard usage page. Up to 20 tags, each 1-50 characters.

items.docs: Classify any brand into Standard Industrial Classification (SIC) codes from its domain or name. Choose between the original SIC system (`original_sic`) or the latest SIC list maintained by the SEC (`latest_sec`).
Use AI to extract specific data points from a brand's website. The AI will crawl the website and extract the requested information based on the provided data points.

info.name: Extract a single product from a URL

items.docs: Given a single URL, determines if it is a product page and extracts the product information.

info.name: Extract products from a brand's website

items.docs: Extract product information from a brand's website. We will analyze the website and return a list of products with details such as name, description, image, pricing, features, and more.
